users_in_dept_for_app.description: Active users in a given department who have access to a specific application.
users_in_dept_for_app.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  u.id,
  u.username,
  u.email,
  u.first_name,
  u.last_name,
  ou.code AS department_code,
  r.code  AS region_code
FROM identity.user_account u
JOIN core.organization_unit ou ON ou.id = u.primary_org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN core.region r ON r.id = ou.region_id
JOIN catalog.application a ON a.code = %(app_code)s
JOIN catalog.application_availability aa ON aa.application_id = a.id
  AND aa.organization_unit_id = ou.id
WHERE ou.code = %(dept_code)s
  AND aa.availability_status = 'AVAILABLE'
  AND (aa.effective_to IS NULL OR aa.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
  AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY u.username
LIMIT 200;

users_in_dept.description: Active users in a given department, regardless of application.
users_in_dept.sql:
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.username,
  u.email,
  u.first_name,
  u.last_name,
  ou.code AS department_code,
  r.code  AS region_code
FROM identity.user_account u
JOIN core.organization_unit ou ON ou.id = u.primary_org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN core.region r ON r.id = ou.region_id
WHERE ou.code = %(dept_code)s
  AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY u.username
LIMIT 200;

departments_for_app.description: Departments that have access to a given application.
departments_for_app.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  ou.code AS department_code,
  ou.name AS department_name,
  r.code  AS region_code,
  aa.availability_status
FROM catalog.application a
JOIN catalog.application_availability aa ON aa.application_id = a.id
JOIN core.organization_unit ou ON ou.id = aa.organization_unit_id
LEFT JOIN core.region r ON r.id = ou.region_id
WHERE a.code = %(app_code)s
  AND aa.availability_status = 'AVAILABLE'
  AND (aa.effective_to IS NULL OR aa.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY r.code, ou.code
LIMIT 200;

app_metadata.description: Metadata for an application such as criticality and lifecycle_state.
app_metadata.sql:
SELECT
  a.code,
  a.name,
  a.criticality,
  a.lifecycle_state
FROM catalog.application a
WHERE a.code = %(app_code)s;

apps_for_dept.description: Applications available to a given department.
apps_for_dept.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.code AS app_code,
  a.name AS app_name,
  a.criticality,
  a.lifecycle_state,
  aa.availability_status,
  r.code AS region_code
FROM catalog.application a
JOIN catalog.application_availability aa ON aa.application_id = a.id
JOIN core.organization_unit ou ON ou.id = aa.organization_unit_id
LEFT JOIN core.region r ON r.id = ou.region_id
WHERE ou.code = %(dept_code)s
  AND aa.availability_status = 'AVAILABLE'
  AND (aa.effective_to IS NULL OR aa.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY a.code
LIMIT 200;
